map.📖 查看「评估（报告自动生成）模板 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Appraisal Report Auto-Generation Template User Guide"
map.评估报告按要素组装：估价对象与权利状况 + 价值时点 + 估价目的 + 价值类型: A report is assembled from its elements: subject property and title + valuation date + purpose + value type + method (comparison, income, cost, hypothetical development) + parameter selection (comparable adjustment factors, cap rate, replacement cost and condition rate) + result + assumptions and limiting conditions; where several methods are used the final value is set by weighting or simple averaging.
map.📚 深度解析：评估报告模板生成: 📚 In-depth: Generating an Appraisal Report Template
map.快速生成评估报告框架节省起草时间。: Produce a report skeleton quickly and save drafting time.
map.按物业类型与方法自动填充结构。: Fill in the structure automatically by property type and method.
map.用于教学或内部模板统一。: Useful for teaching or standardizing internal templates.
map.生成「高层住宅 80㎡ 两居」报告，采用市场比较法，重点因素：楼层朝向、装修状况: Generate a report for a "high-rise residential unit, 80 sqm, two bedrooms" using the sales comparison approach, focusing on floor and orientation, fit-out condition, school catchment and age depreciation; the valuation range is given automatically as 80-200 (a random example to be replaced with real data).
map.模板支持市场比较法/收益法/成本法/假设开发法/基准地价修正法，按物业特征选用，: The template supports the sales comparison, income, cost, hypothetical development and base land price adjustment methods, chosen by property characteristics; figures must be checked and filled in by a registered appraiser after generation.
map.生成的数值能直接用吗？: Can the generated figures be used directly?
map.不能，模板价为随机示例，仅提供结构，正式报告须代入真实案例与评估依据。: No. Template values are random examples that only provide structure; a formal report must use real cases and appraisal evidence.
map.报告必备要素？: What are the essential elements of a report?
map.委托方、评估目的、基准日、方法、过程、结论、评估师签章，缺项不具法律效力。: Client, purpose, valuation date, method, process, conclusion and the appraiser's signature; any omission removes legal effect.
